summary: A man was accused of rape and cheating after a consensual relationship ended. The complainant alleged that sexual consent was obtained through deceit regarding marriage. The Supreme Court reviewed the case originating from Kerala. The court discharged the man of all criminal charges. It ruled that physical intimacy during a consensual relationship cannot later be branded as rape.
title: Supreme Court discharges man of rape charges after relationship sours
verification_note: Approved case where the Supreme Court discharged/quashed rape and cheating charges in a Kerala matter.

summary: A man allegedly sexually harassed a visiting tourist and tore her dress during the night. One man was accused of committing the offence. The incident took place in Thiruvananthapuram district. Police registered a criminal case and arrested the accused with the help of video footage. The accused will be produced before a court for remand while further investigation continues.
title: Police arrest man for sexually harassing tourist in Kerala
